title: Wire transfers and scam payments
facts: Scammers often demand payment methods that are difficult to reverse, including wire transfers, gift cards, cryptocurrency or cash.
A legitimate government agency or business generally should not demand payment by gift card as the only way to resolve a debt, fine or emergency.
A consumer who sent money to a scammer should contact the payment provider immediately and ask whether the transaction can be stopped or reversed, although recovery is not guaranteed.
Fraud should also be reported through appropriate federal, state or local channels.
